title: Animate the small e and remove its visible move label
statement: User requested blinking, coughing and smoke-blowing cycles with no text underneath e. Removed the move grip/tooltip, transferred keyboard movement to e itself and added sparse idle cues plus CSS/SVG expressions. Dragging, authored placement, no hiding and the selected character are preserved.
conditions: Visible label removal does not remove accessible keyboard movement.
Paused, hidden and reduced-motion states stop cues.
No LLM connection or human review authored.
